env.name: ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Where zip archives are written when ARCHIVE_STORAGE=local (the default). Defaults to ./generated/archives if unset.

env.name: ARCHIVE_STORAGE
env.description: Where the finished zip is saved: "local" (default) or "gcs" (a Google Cloud Storage bucket).

env.name: ARCHIVE_GCS_BUCKET
env.description: GCS bucket name to upload the zip to — required when ARCHIVE_STORAGE=gcs. Auth is via Application Default Credentials / GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, same as any other Google Cloud client.

env.name: ARCHIVE_GCS_PREFIX
env.description: Optional object name prefix inside the GCS bucket (e.g. "campaigns/summer/"). Only used when ARCHIVE_STORAGE=gcs.

env.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON
env.description: Only needed if the default Application Default Credentials (a GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS file path, gcloud login, or the cloud metadata server) can't sign a URL — paste the entire contents of a service-account key JSON file downloaded from the GCP Console (IAM & Admin > Service Accounts > Keys > Add Key). Takes priority over any other credentials when set. Also read by loopengine core's own /storage-redirect route (adapters/http.ts), which is what actually signs the zip's URL now — see create_zip_archive.ts's own saveArchive doc comment.
